title: Ion Drive Air Purification Simulator
description: A virtual city is suffering from visible chemical smog composed of NO2, SO2, and O3 pollutant particles. The user must position and activate a large ion drive purification device above the city, tune its ionization frequency to target specific pollutant molecules, and trigger catalytic reactions that neutralize the toxic compounds into harmless byproducts, clearing the city's atmosphere layer by layer.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 that implements an interactive ion-drive air purification chemistry simulation. Load both GLB assets using GLTFLoader from a CDN. Place the VirtualCity model at the scene origin on a ground plane. Scale it appropriately so it fills the lower portion of the view. Surround the city with a translucent yellowish-brown smog layer made of hundreds of small sphere particles representing three pollutant types: NO2 (brown), SO2 (yellow), and O3 (pale blue). Each particle should have a label or color legend shown in an HTML overlay. Load the PrimaryIonDrive model and position it above the city, slightly off to one side. Add OrbitControls for camera navigation. Set up directional and ambient lighting with a hazy atmosphere using fog. The interaction steps are: (1) The user clicks and drags the ion drive to reposition it over the densest smog cluster above the city. A ghost outline shows valid placement zones. (2) A slider UI appears allowing the user to set the ionization frequency to one of three wavelengths, each targeting one pollutant type. (3) The user clicks an Activate button, causing the ion drive to emit a visible conical beam of glowing particles downward into the city smog. (4) Pollutant particles matching the selected frequency undergo a catalytic reaction animation: they split apart, flash, and transform into green safe-molecule particles that drift downward and fade. Non-matching pollutants remain. (5) The user repeats frequency selection and activation for the remaining two pollutant types. Track progress with a Purity Meter bar that fills from 0% to 100%. When all three pollutant types are neutralized, the fog clears, the city brightens with increased light intensity, and a success banner displays the balanced chemical equations for each reaction: 2NO2 -> N2 + 2O2, SO2 + H2O -> H2SO3 neutralized, O3 -> O2 + O. Use requestAnimationFrame for smooth animation of all particle movements and beam effects.
